scientific_limitations: Fixed spatial mean diffusivity, one-dimensional zero-drift Stratonovich transport, interior launch, intrinsic-coordinate interface. The two-level optimizer and its cubic are treated as a specialization of the published stationarity condition. The finding concerns strict gain monotonicity and the two sharp gain limits, not priority for the optimizer or its limiting budget allocation.
title: Strict launch-position gain and sharp endpoint laws for budgeted Stratonovich escape
